candidates.title: Musk says FSD v15 wide release is next month with the holiday update
candidates.whyItMightMatter: December wide-release claim names a new UI plus HOV and late-merge fixes, not unsupervised driving

candidates.title: Italy grants provisional approval for Tesla Assisted Driving, its 12th European country
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First large EU market to clear supervised TAD, at €99 a month, ahead of a bloc-wide vote

candidates.title: Korea says it still cannot review Tesla's China-built FSD exemption
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Nov. 20 ministry notice that the Oct. 22 China-built filing lacks enough detail for a technical review

candidates.title: Tesla plans a €3 billion Giga Berlin hall for up to 1 million Cybercabs a year
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Permit filing is later this year, construction H1 2027, and Cybercab output is aimed at 2029

candidates.title: Texas registry adds 200 Cybercabs in one day, taking the count to 773
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Nov. 17 batch put Cybercabs ahead of Model Ys on the Texas list; registration is not riders in service

candidates.title: Public Cybercab rides with no wheel or pedals open in Dallas
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Second city after Austin for public rides in the purpose-built no-controls vehicle

candidates.title: Miami Robotaxi geofence roughly doubles, still short of the beach
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Service area grew from about 31 to about 59 square miles and now includes downtown; Miami Beach is still out

candidates.title: Musk says customer-owned Robotaxi trials may start next month
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Conditional December pilot would pull ahead of the Q2 2027 timing given on the Q3 call

candidates.title: Musk describes a driverless Model Y for six or seven people
candidates.whyItMightMatter: DealBook comment of a no-wheel Model Y for groups Cybercab cannot seat, with no date, price, or factory

candidates.title: Cybercab invite screens list 279 miles of EPA-estimated range
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Buyer screenshots add range, 15-minute charge claim, and a 4-year/50,000-mile basic warranty; EPA label is an estimate

candidates.title: Robotaxi first-responder guides cite 85 mph roads and new Cybercab hardware
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Nov. 20 guides say Cybercab and Model Y are designed for posted limits up to 85 mph and note trunk Starlink plus a trunk camera

candidates.title: Drone photos show possible Giga Press pads at the Austin Optimus factory
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Four reinforced foundations are being poured; Tesla has not confirmed the machines, and the plant was still under construction last quarter

candidates.title: 2026.44.1 starts rolling out and still carries supervised FSD v14.3.13
candidates.whyItMightMatter: New firmware train adds a charging map and is not labeled the holiday update; FSD in the notes is still v14.3.13

candidates.title: Tesla opens Argentina orders for Shanghai-built Model 3 and Model Y
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Direct sales started Nov. 21 with five trims from $40,990, but first deliveries are not expected until March or April 2027

candidates.title: Musk stops at Giga Shanghai and pledges more China production without a number
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Visit covered manufacturing, driver assistance, and Optimus; the output pledge had no target while October China retail stayed at the already-reported low
